beats.title: A trader CLI plugin, fully guarded
bullets: Every write routed through Agent Wallet
Signing, policy and MFA are never bypassed
beats.narration: This is PoPo dot meme on Monad testnet, and an installable command-line plugin for the MetaMask Agent Wallet. It turns our prediction and meme-coin trading venue into trader commands, while every signature and transaction is enforced by the Agent Wallet itself.

beats.title: Markets without a login
bullets: vault & position reads via public RPC
beats.narration: Read-only commands such as markets, quote, vault and position run against a public Monad RPC. They need no key and no login, so an agent can inspect the venue safely before asking the wallet to do anything.

beats.title: Quote matches the fill, wei for wei
beats.narration: Before a trade, the plugin prices the bonding curve locally. Here, one NO share costs about twelve P dollars. After the fill we will check that the vault balance changes by exactly this amount, wei for wei.

beats.title: Nothing is whitelisted
beats.narration: Crucially, the wallet is in guard mode with a strict policy. The allowlist is empty, Monad testnet is not pre-approved, and the rolling spend limit is zero. We are not using beast mode and we never whitelist our own contracts.

beats.title: An email MFA is mandatory
beats.narration: Now a real write: deposit twenty-five P dollars from the ERC20 wallet into the trading vault. The command pauses at awaiting MFA. The owner opens the email, approves the exact request, and only then is the transaction signed and broadcast.

beats.title: A second MFA for the trade
beats.narration: The second write buys one NO share. It triggers a brand-new approval email. Each transaction needs its own human confirmation, so consent can never be silently replayed by the plugin or an agent.

beats.title: Position and vault reconciled
bullets: vault spends exactly the quoted cost
beats.narration: After approval, the receipt succeeds. The position now holds one NO share, and the vault has spent exactly the quoted price. The explorer confirms the transaction and gas used.

beats.title: The same trade lands in HyperIndex
beats.narration: The same trade is immediately ingested by our Envio HyperIndex indexer as a PredictionTrade row in the same block, showing how the plugin composes with an indexed, analytics-ready backend.

beats.title: Powerful for agents, safe by default
bullets: no private keys or tokens handled
no bypass of signing, policy or MFA
beats.narration: An installable plugin with nine commands, zero key handling by us, and every write gated by Agent Wallet signing, policy and email MFA. Powerful for agents, safe by default. Thank you.
